role: A post-open p14 mechanism audit of whether the independently validated v199 fixed-identity full-DCT initializer can be represented without an online full-DCT scan or a retained dense response. It inherits v199/v204 physical scoring only after full-trajectory coordinate equivalence is independently established. It is not fresh validation, external evidence, a wall/RSS result, or real BOST.
scientific_question: Can the dense camera-resolved full-DCT fixed-identity initializer be replaced, for both five and nine active cameras, by a camera-permutation-invariant packed normal cache plus the exact adjoint of the detector-potential integration map, while preserving all 2626 sealed p14 coordinates and reducing the retained geometry-cache value count?

allowed_inputs: sealed v199 coordinates only for post-prediction equivalence comparison
sealed independently validated v199/v204 metrics only for inherited scoring
forbidden_inputs: frame index or time as a prediction feature
trajectory label as a prediction feature
data_isolation.prediction_barrier: All compact coordinates, packed-cache diagnostics, adjoint checks, and hashes are sealed before parent coordinates or parent metrics are read for comparison.

primary.name: potential_normal_packed_cholesky_tau2m8
primary.observation_map: For each active camera, integrate the centered two-component BOS observation with the frozen constrained zero-mean detector-gradient least-squares map P.
primary.response_identity: The full non-DC orthonormal DCT response H and potential response M=PAB^T satisfy H H^T=M^T M and h H^T=p M because every camera potential is zero mean.
primary.normal_cache: G=M^T M, lambda=(2^-8)^2*lambda_max(G), and only the packed lower Cholesky factor of G+lambda I is retained; M and all full-DCT features are forbidden deployment-cache state.
primary.online_rhs: Apply an independently audited exact transpose P^T to p, then one exact vector A^T, then the fixed affine-basis transpose to obtain p M without storing M.
primary.solve: Two triangular solves with the packed lower Cholesky factor.

frozen_numerical_contract.potential_gauge: one zero-sum constraint per active camera
frozen_numerical_contract.independent_solve: numpy.linalg.eigh spectral solve without importing the v205 core module

cache_and_call_contract.setup_disclosure: The formal audit may transiently construct M to freeze G and compare identities. This is an offline geometry-build cost and prevents any whole-pipeline peak-RSS claim until a separately frozen streaming setup is measured.

inherited_accuracy_boundary.all_nine: v199 fixed-identity K1 is independently sealed at 1313/1313 strict cells and 13/13 complete groups; v204 independently identifies dense-representation call headroom.
inherited_accuracy_boundary.five_camera: v199 fixed-identity K1 is independently sealed as failing 45/1313 strict cells and passing only 3/13 complete groups. v205 must preserve this negative boundary and may not claim five-camera matched accuracy.
inherited_accuracy_boundary.inheritance_condition: No accuracy result is inherited unless compact coordinates match sealed v199 coordinates on all 2626 cells and both independent implementations pass every numerical and binding gate.

fixed_decision_order: Any source, parent, observation, geometry, affine, shape, finite, rank, gauge, transpose-adjoint, Gram, factor, solve, permutation, cache-count, seal, or independent-comparison failure makes v205 inconclusive.

If either five- or nine-camera compact coordinates differ from sealed v199 fixed-identity coordinates beyond 1e-8 relative error, conclude FAIL_POTENTIAL_NORMAL_COMPACT_EQUIVALENCE_V205 and close this exact compact normal representation.
If packed-cache value counts do not meet both preregistered compression ratios, conclude FAIL_POTENTIAL_NORMAL_CACHE_REDUCTION_V205.

Only if all 2626 coordinates match, both cache ratios pass, the all-nine inherited parent remains 1313/1313 and 13/13, and independent validation passes may conclude PASS_POTENTIAL_NORMAL_COMPACT_CACHE_V205.

A positive result proves only post-open numerical/cache representation headroom. It adds one exact vector adjoint relative to dense K1 and does not establish wall/RSS speedup, fresh validation, external generalization, curved rays, real BOST, paper success, or algorithm breakthrough.
failure_action: A valid failure closes the packed potential-normal representation. Do not tune tau, change the detector integration, add sketches, alter tolerances, or rescue it with CNN/FNO/UNO/DeepONet or GPU training.
